title: Subsidy use body
description: What the host's meter recorded an agent using of its grant on one day (residency.md 5, register row DK85; spec-delta S300). Signed by the Host DID: one per grant per day, in the grant's units, within the daily cap, the grant and what the budget has left (subsidy_exceeded, subsidy_exhausted). meter_hash is the hash of the host's meter extract for the day, so the record reconciles to metered usage. Chain: none (prev is null).
